name: DicFace — Dirichlet-Constrained Variational Codebook for Temporally Coherent Video Face Restoration
notes: Replaces CodeFormer with a Dirichlet-continuous VQ-VAE codebook + spatio-temporal Transformer. Eliminates inter-frame flicker for sequential portrait and photobooth pipelines. Weights on GitHub. ~8-12 GB VRAM. Tier 1.

name: DicFace — Dirichlet-Constrained Variational Codebook for Temporally Coherent Video Face Restoration
notes: Swap CodeFormer stage only; Real-ESRGAN upscale stage unchanged. Same weights as build_face_restore entry. Tier 1.

name: DA3-LARGE-1.1 — Depth Anything 3 improved checkpoint (Apache 2.0)
notes: Drop-in checkpoint upgrade. Apache 2.0 license (vs CC-BY-NC-4.0 for original DA3-LARGE). Improved accuracy. GGUF packaging active in window (Jun 15-16). ~4-6 GB VRAM. Tier 1.

name: DA3-LARGE-1.1 — Depth Anything 3 improved checkpoint (Apache 2.0)
notes: Same DA3 family used for normal estimation. Same checkpoint upgrade applies. Tier 1.

name: SeedVR2-3B — One-Step Video Restoration (ByteDance, Comfy-Org official weights)
notes: Promote from archive. Archived workflow at scaffold/workflows/_archived_R135/seedvr2_video_upscale.json already has correct node class SeedVR2LoadVAEModel. Model is live with official Comfy-Org weights and mxfp8/nvfp4 quants. Single inference step (10-20x faster than multi-step). Tier 1.

name: DLoRAL — Dual LoRA Learning for Detail-Rich Temporally Consistent Video Super-Resolution
notes: SD-based one-step VSR with dual LoRA branches (temporal consistency + spatial detail). GitHub weights released Jun 18. Verify SD backbone version (SD1.5 vs XL) before integrating. ~8-12 GB VRAM estimated. No community validation on RTX 5060 Ti yet. Tier 2.

name: Wan2.2 14B I2V Lightning — 8-step distilled I2V
notes: Community quantization of official Wan-AI/Wan2.2 Lightning checkpoint. 8-step inference vs 20-40. ~60-75% faster. Needs lightning scheduler params exposed in build_wan_video. Tier 2.

name: Wan2.2 Animate 14B nvfp4 ComfyUI
notes: nvfp4 ComfyUI-native quantization of Wan2.2 Animate 14B. New motion-guided I2V mode. Extension of existing builder, not replacement. Tier 2.

name: Controllable and Expressive One-Shot Video Head Swapping (paper only)
notes: Diffusion-based head swap with 3DMM-driven expression retargeting + shape-agnostic masks + hair enhancement. Addresses Klein headswap failure modes. Paper only — no weights yet. Expect release in 2-4 weeks. Tier 3 until weights drop.

name: CanonSwap — Canonical Space Video Face Swapping
notes: Outside window (Jul 2025). No public weights. Temporally consistent video face swap vs per-frame GAN (ReActor). Watch for weights. Tier 3.

name: DreamID-V — Diffusion Transformer Video Face Swap (paper only)
notes: Highest-traction diffusion face swap paper (53 upvotes). Still paper-only as of survey date. Highest-priority face swap watch item. Tier 3.

name: Pixal3D — Pixel-Aligned Image-to-3D Generation (Tencent)
notes: Outside window (May 2026). No public weights. Better pixel fidelity via back-projection conditioning. 33 upvotes, active discussion. Tier 3.

name: Mix3R — Feed-forward + Generative 3D Reconstruction
notes: Outside window (May 2026). No public weights. MoT architecture for joint reconstruction + pose estimation. Yebin Liu group (Tsinghua) typically releases code. Tier 3.

name: PiD — Pixel Diffusion Decoder (NVIDIA)
notes: Outside window (May 2026). Tutorial weights only on Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image (not SDXL). NVIDIA paper, 46 upvotes. Watch for official standalone weights. Augments VAE decode step. Tier 3.

name: HSA — Heterogeneous Step Allocation for DiT video inference acceleration
notes: Outside window (May 2026). Training-free inference wrapper for WAN-2 and LTX-2. 2-4x speedup. No model change, no extra VRAM. High priority augmentation once ComfyUI wrapper available. Tier 2.

name: HSA — Heterogeneous Step Allocation for DiT video inference acceleration
notes: Outside window (May 2026). Same HSA paper — directly targets WAN-2 and LTX-2. Tier 2.

name: FLUX.2-klein-9b-kv — Official KV-cache Klein 9B variant (Black Forest Labs)
notes: Outside window (Mar 2026). Official BFL KV-cache variant. fp8 sibling fits 16 GB. 64K downloads. Drop-in Klein weight swap. Evaluate on next Klein upgrade cycle. Tier 3.

name: FLUX.2-small-decoder — Lighter Flux2 VAE decoder (Black Forest Labs)
notes: Outside window (Apr 2026). VAE-only swap, saves ~1-2 GB at decode. 200K downloads. Works for all Klein and Flux1-dev builders. Tier 3 (local test needed).

name: Muapi anime color-trace LoRA (Illustrious/SDXL)
notes: In window (Jun 17). Style LoRA for Illustrious/SDXL. No pipeline change. Additive aesthetic option for anime workflows. Tier 2.

name: SCAIL-2 — Pose-Driven Cross-Identity Character Animation
notes: Just outside window (Jun 9, updated Jun 18). MIT license, official Comfy-Org weights, 6.5K GGUF downloads. New capability: animate a pose video as a target identity. New builder build_scail2_character_animate needed. Tier 2.

name: ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper upstream — potential Wan2.2 Animate/Lightning breakage
notes: RISK ALERT. New mirror created Jun 16 suggests upstream wrapper changes. Pin to last known-good commit before pulling. Audit node class names. Not a new model — a potential silent breakage vector.

name: CUDA 13 / PyTorch 2.12 ComfyUI portable — ONNX breaking change
notes: RISK ALERT. CUDA 13 / PyTorch 2.12 portable build breaks onnxruntime-gpu built for cu12x. ReActor (inswapper_128.onnx) and MTB face tools will fail. Do NOT upgrade to this bundle.

name: VMoBA — Mixture-of-Block Attention for Video Diffusion (research)
notes: Research only. Sparse attention for long video DiT inference. Not yet a ComfyUI node. Monitor KJNodes and HunyuanVideoWrapper PRs. Tier 3.

name: Edit2Restore — FLUX.1 Kontext LoRA for Few-Shot Image Restoration
notes: Outside window (Jan 2026). No public weights. Kontext LoRA for dehazing/deraining/denoising — more modern than SDXL-based SUPIR. Monitor for weights release. Tier 3.
